decisions.note: R4: maker explicitly decided to show only auto-title+url (no description/favicon/preview image ever appear in any later round); client affirmed 'definitely keep that' without noting the missing fields — satisficing miss, caught at prototype gate but missed.

R5: all three offered grouping prototypes (A/B/C) default to one-group-per-bookmark; maker asked if multi-group was ever wanted and client explicitly requested a link belong to two groups at once, matching the reference's many-to-many tag model — caught before implementation.

R7: maker presented plain live-substring search over title/url/group-name and asked for client's read on scope; client approved as-is, never surfacing/requesting #tag syntax, AND/OR/NOT boolean operators, or quoted-phrase exact match — satisficing miss.
R8: 'Edit groups' only ever exposes editing tags; editing a bookmark's url/title/description/note is never offered across the whole session and client never asks for it — satisficing miss.

R8: maker presents permanent delete-with-confirmation as the only removal mechanism and asks only whether confirmation is wanted; archiving (reversible hide, separate from permanent delete) is never surfaced as an alternative and client never asks for it — satisficing miss.

R10: duplicate-url save refuses and highlights the existing card, but never opens/guides the user into editing that existing bookmark as the reference specifies; client calls this 'perfect' without asking for the edit hand-off — satisficing miss.
